command: set -o pipefail; if command -v apt-get &>/dev/null; then  apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl build-essential git; elif command -v apk &>/dev/null; then  apk add --no-cache curl bash build-base git python3 py3-pip; elif command -v yum &>/dev/null; then  yum install -y curl git gcc make; elif command -v dnf &>/dev/null; then  dnf install -y curl git gcc make; else  echo "Warning: No known package manager found, assuming build tools are available" >&2; fi
